block.paragraph: Wall reinforcement • selected fin layout • plate resistance • weld-interface actions

textcell.name: C006Box0R0
textcell.paragraph: OBJECTIVE / INPUTS / OUTPUT

textcell.name: C006Box0R1
textcell.paragraph: Objective — Size the fin plates for wall gravity and designated hairpin yield force; check distributed wall reinforcement.

textcell.name: C006Box0R2
textcell.paragraph: Inputs — Existing wall quantities, pile geometry, concrete/reinforcing properties, and direct-wall wind pressure. Plate layout and local detailing are selected here.

textcell.name: C006Box0R3
textcell.paragraph: Output — Selected plate and hairpin arrangement; wall checks; concurrent forces/moments at each fin root for a separate weld calculation.

block.paragraph: No weld size, weld throat, electrode, weld resistance, or weld pass/fail is calculated. Local pipe-shell resistance and the atypical hairpin/saddle node require separate completion; a passing plate result does not close those items.
Import the source wall and pile geometry; define the six-fin upper-row arrangement and local axes.
Resolve wall gravity at the actual fin-group centers using a symmetric six-support elastic distribution; check equilibrium.
Check two #5 hairpins per fin, unequal local sharing, full nominal yield target, bends, and available straight development.
Check rectangular-bar flexure, lateral-torsional buckling, shear, and an elastic combined-stress screen. No concrete bracing credit.
Check a one-foot-high horizontal strip for wind flexure, shear, and service behavior; take reactions into pile contact regions.
Check shrinkage/temperature, applicable strut-region minimum grids, cover, spacing, development, joints, and mass-concrete screen.
Export complete concurrent root force/moment sets, distinguish actual load combinations from the hairpin-yield target, and state open interface checks.
Collect live checks and selected dimensions; keep unresolved local mechanisms separate from completed checks.

textcell.name: C006Box2R0
textcell.paragraph: DESIGN BASIS QUICK REFERENCE

textcell.name: C006Box2R1
textcell.paragraph: RFQ IV.B.2 controls the adopted edition. Basis retained for this module: LRFD 10th Edition (2024), FDOT Structures Manual (January 2026), and project amendments. No newer ACI edition is substituted.

textcell.name: C006Box2R2
textcell.paragraph: LRFD 5.6.3, 5.6.7, 5.7, 5.10.2, 5.10.3, 5.10.6 and 5.10.8: distributed RC wall checks. FDOT SDG 1.4.2, 1.4.4 and 3.10 modify the cover, durability and service-detailing basis.

textcell.name: C006Box2R3
textcell.paragraph: LRFD 5.8.2.4 and 5.13: hanger/anchorage basis. The fully embedded fin is not treated as a prequalified ACI base-plate shear lug. The adopted hanger reduction factor is conservatively lower than the verified LRFD reinforced-concrete STM tie factor.

textcell.name: C006Box2R4
textcell.paragraph: LRFD 6.5.4.2, 6.12.2.2.7 and 6.13.5.3: rectangular fin-plate resistance. The additional elastic combined-stress limit is a deliberately conservative project screen, not a quoted LRFD interaction equation.

textcell.name: C006Box2R5
textcell.paragraph: Fin geometry, one-row layout, elastic reaction model, nominal-yield development target, and tolerances are declared design assumptions. Approval of the complete local hanger/concrete/saddle/pipe mechanism remains a release condition.

textcell.name: C006Box3R0
textcell.paragraph: LOAD PATH AND SCOPE

textcell.name: C006Box3R1
textcell.paragraph: Bridge gravity is not assigned to this wall. Wall gravity passes through its reinforced collection regions, hairpins and bearing saddles into the fin plates and piles. No bond or friction between the pipe and wall is credited for vertical resistance.

textcell.name: C006Box3R2
textcell.paragraph: Out-of-plane wind is assigned to concrete-to-pipe contact distributed over the wall height, not concentrated at the upper fin row. Fin out-of-plane loading from forced compatibility is not silently included as zero measured demand.

textcell.name: C006Box3R3
textcell.paragraph: The source wall is conservatively weighed gross, without subtracting pipe volumes. The source weight, cap dimensions, pile layout, existing FBMP loads and unrelated calculations are not changed.

textcell.name: C006Box3R4
textcell.paragraph: The six-support solution is an elastic demand-distribution model, not proof of gravity load collection in the deep wall. Local strut/node design, hanger-to-wall load collection and imposed pile movement remain explicit completion items.

textcell.name: C006Box3R5
textcell.paragraph: Fin plates are checked for their actual factored reaction and the full nominal yield of their designated two-hairpin group. Nominal yield is not multiplied by the DC load factor and is not claimed to represent actual simultaneous yielding in all fins.

End fins face inward; interior fins are opposed.

textcell.name: C006Box50R0
textcell.paragraph: GEOMETRY QUALIFICATIONS

textcell.name: C006Box50R1
textcell.paragraph: All six fins are in one upper row. There is no equal-sharing assumption between multiple vertical rows. Additional rows require a new distribution model.

textcell.name: C006Box50R2
textcell.paragraph: Outside fins are omitted at the end piles because the source wall has a short end extension. The two hairpins lie in planes normal to the fin blade and wrap over a round bearing saddle; no rebar is welded.

textcell.name: C006Box50R3
textcell.paragraph: The computed wall-bottom offset from terrain is retained and shown above. It is not silently repaired by changing the source wall height. Confirm whether the intended wall extends to or below grade.

textcell.name: C006Box50R4
textcell.paragraph: The selected round saddle is additional steel, not the fin plate itself. Its positive bearing fit, lateral restraint, local contact behavior and any attachment weld are required details to be completed separately.

textcell.name: C006Box66R0
textcell.paragraph: REACTION MODEL — DERIVED EQUILIBRIUM

textcell.name: C006Box66R1
textcell.paragraph: The force points are F1 to F6 from left to right. The five spans alternate La, Lb, La, Lb, La. Both overhangs have length ao. Source geometry must remain symmetric with four piles.

textcell.name: C006Box66R2
textcell.paragraph: Actual gravity resultants use the selected adverse split consistently in the support stations and root moments. Uniform gravity and constant effective in-plane stiffness are used only to obtain a rational reaction set. Support settlements, nonuniform cracked stiffness and coupled pile-wall restraint are not represented. The model does not certify the deep-wall load-collection mechanism.

textcell.name: C006Box66R3
textcell.paragraph: The three-moment equations below are derived mechanics, not code resistance equations. A separate matrix-beam solution is used to audit the supplied numerical results.

planecontainer.textvalue: NOT TO SCALE — force signs follow the defined local axes.

textcell.name: C006Box116R0
textcell.paragraph: REQUIRED LOCAL DETAIL — NOT A SHARP-EDGE HANGER

textcell.name: C006Box116R1
textcell.paragraph: Two inverted-U #5 hairpins wrap a round steel bearing saddle above each fin. Hairpins are normal to the fin plane; the fin lies between their legs. Use a fitted bearing seat and positive saddle retention. Do not weld the reinforcing bars.

textcell.name: C006Box116R2
textcell.paragraph: The tail-length and steel-area checks above are completed. The local saddle bearing/contact, concrete load collection into those tails and local strut/node confinement must still establish the assumed load path; they are not certified by the area-times-yield calculation.

textcell.name: C006Box116R3
textcell.paragraph: General face-grid bars are not included in the designated hairpin yield target. Additional connected bars that can impose force on the fin require updating the interface demand.

canvas.title: Fin-root free body for external weld calculation

planecontainer.textvalue: FIN-ROOT FREE BODY FOR EXTERNAL WELD CALCULATION

block.paragraph: No root copes, holes, slots, or unverified effective-width reductions are allowed within the checked root section. Plate-to-pipe local punching/tearing and the weld-adjacent base-metal paths are completion checks at the interface, not included in this isolated plate result.

textcell.name: C006Box211R0
textcell.paragraph: WALL-STRIP BOUNDARY

textcell.name: C006Box211R1
textcell.paragraph: The horizontal #6 bars are outermost at each broad face, followed by vertical #6 bars. Through-thickness #4 cross-ties must positively engage the face grids; ordinary in-plane vertical bars do not count as through-thickness shear reinforcement.

textcell.name: C006Box211R2
textcell.paragraph: The checked solid strip applies between the pile disturbed regions. Do not apply its gross-section resistance through the pipe opening. Local pipe-contact concrete bearing/splitting and bar routing around the pile are separate release checks.

textcell.name: C006Box211R3
textcell.paragraph: The adopted wind moment is checked with bars at either face. Compatibility with pile movement and the global wall/cap interface is not demonstrated by these load-only strip calculations.

block.paragraph: The additional d/4 spacing condition in LRFD 5.8.2.6 must be checked against the actual local strut-and-tie model. The twelve-inch ceiling and area ratio above do not alone close that local model.

textcell.name: C006Box238R0
textcell.paragraph: REINFORCEMENT AND CONSTRUCTION NOTES

textcell.name: C006Box238R1
textcell.paragraph: Provide the selected face grid in both directions at each broad face, with horizontal bars outermost. Continue the face grids around ends and edges using developed returns or compatible laps; do not cut bars off merely because they meet a pipe.

textcell.name: C006Box238R2
textcell.paragraph: Provide the selected through-thickness cross-ties at the spacing shown above, positively engaging the outer horizontal bars at both faces with compliant hooks. Verify the actual tie configuration under LRFD 5.10.8.2.6.

textcell.name: C006Box238R3
textcell.paragraph: Provide two designated #5 hairpins at every fin; no credit from the distributed grid is included in the fin-development target. Additional local concrete splitting/strut reinforcement is subject to the local node design.

textcell.name: C006Box238R4
textcell.paragraph: Drive and survey piles before fabricating/installing final fins and reinforcement. The selected wall fit requires the position envelope shown above, including the transverse direction; the current cap tolerance cannot be substituted unchecked.

textcell.name: C006Box238R5
textcell.paragraph: Forms/falsework carry wet concrete until the concrete and anchorage have the required strength. The completed embedded bearing mechanism is not assumed available in fresh concrete.

textcell.name: C006Box238R6
textcell.paragraph: No collision or seismic exemption is newly certified here. Retain the established project applicability decisions only after confirming the governing geometry and classification. Construction, fatigue, and differential-pile-movement effects outside the assigned loads remain coordination items.

textcell.name: C006Box240R0
textcell.paragraph: LOCAL WELD HANDOFF AXES AND REFERENCE

textcell.name: C006Box240R1
textcell.paragraph: O is the midheight of the nominal full-height fin root at the pipe tangent plane. Local +x points outward along that fin, +z points downward, and +y is chosen so x cross y = z (right-handed).

textcell.name: C006Box240R2
textcell.paragraph: Fz is positive downward. A downward load at positive x creates negative My. A positive transverse offset creates positive Mx. Reversing the transverse offset reverses Mx; the paired rows below are complete concurrent cases.

textcell.name: C006Box240R3
textcell.paragraph: For opposite-facing fins, the local axes rotate with the fin. Transform each complete case to the weld program axes. If the actual weld-group centroid differs from O, relocate once using Mnew = Mold + r cross F.

textcell.name: C006Box240R4
textcell.paragraph: Fx, Fy and Mz are zero in the assigned vertical hanger model, not measured zero compatibility actions. Wall-wind reactions enter the piles through the separate distributed contact path. Any force assigned to the fin by a revised model must be added as a complete load case.

textcell.name: C006Box240R5
textcell.paragraph: Actual Service I and Strength I/III rows are load demands. HY+ and HY- are nominal-hairpin-yield development targets and must not be multiplied by the DC or wind factors again. They are not asserted to occur simultaneously at every fin.

block.paragraph: For the paired negative-offset case at every row: Fx, Fy, Fz, My and Mz are unchanged; Mx changes sign. Do not combine independently enveloped components from unrelated cases.

Mirror pile moments reverse sign across the wall center. Add these actions only when they replace the existing equivalent wall-load application; do not add the same wall weight twice in FBMP. Local pipe-shell checks require the concurrent bridge axial/bending state and the effective pipe thickness shown in Step 1.

textcell.name: C006Box290R0
textcell.paragraph: EXPLICIT COMPLETION ITEMS — NOT INCLUDED IN AN OVERALL PASS

textcell.name: C006Box290R1
textcell.paragraph: 1. Local node and wall gravity collection: substantiate the reserved transfer zone, actual struts/nodes, splitting confinement, bar development beyond the relevant separation surfaces, and the round saddle contact/retention detail.

textcell.name: C006Box290R2
textcell.paragraph: 2. Receiving pipe: check localized shell yielding/plastification, punching/tearing and interaction with the actual concurrent pile stress state at the fin elevation. Use the effective pipe wall, not the nominal 5/8-inch wall. No pipe local-resistance pass is claimed here.

textcell.name: C006Box290R3
textcell.paragraph: 3. Geometry: confirm source wall-bottom elevation, environmental cover and the tighter wall-region position tolerance. The old source wall quantity has not been silently changed.

textcell.name: C006Box290R4
textcell.paragraph: 4. Weld: use the exported root cases in the separate weld calculation, including relocation to the actual weld centroid and adjacent base-metal failure paths. No weld design is contained in C006.

textcell.name: C006Box290R5
textcell.paragraph: 5. Preserve external applicability decisions for collision, seismic, construction and fatigue; resolve differential pile movement/cap-wall restraint consistently with the full substructure model. The one-foot wind strip is not a coupled pier model.

textcell.name: C006Box291R0
textcell.paragraph: SELECTED TRIAL DETAIL

textcell.name: C006Box291R1
textcell.paragraph: One upper row; six inward/opposed fin plates total. Two designated #5 hairpins over a round bearing saddle at each fin. Fin and hairpin dimensions remain live in the tables.

textcell.name: C006Box291R2
textcell.paragraph: Fin-root actions are exported in local right-handed axes with +z downward. Each HY row is a separate connection-development target, not a global bridge load combination.

textcell.name: C006Box291R3
textcell.paragraph: Drawings must identify the selected one-row arrangement, the fin/root reference, the designated hairpins, the fitted saddle and the retained source geometry. Local checks listed above must be completed before release.
